title: Powered A/B of the Remember record on the stop-attribution case
body:
Outcome: a preregistered A/B with ~15 reps per arm prints per-case repeat counts and a Fisher exact p for stop-attribution-unchecked (pass = run completes with exit 0 for both arms).
Evidence: #1489 pilot: stop-attribution-unchecked 5/5 before vs 3/5 after (Fisher one-sided p=0.22), guard cases 0/5. Grader frozen in #1489.
Do: preregister ~15 reps per arm, sonnet, harness c8d0aff vs current main, same 4 cases and grader; check quota first (cswap).
Proof: per-case counts with Fisher p for the primary.
Files: evals/replay/agent-replay.ts, evals/replay/agent-replay-cases.ts
